Simple Hinglish purpose: Har environment ke resources ko logically alag rakhna aur ownership clear karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Separate dev/qa/prod Terraform roots; VPC and resources created. No AWS account boundary is created.
Azure implementation and code status: Resource Group created by each environment root; all roots target the configured subscription.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Existing project is selected; required APIs enabled by Terraform. Project itself is not created.
Production decision or gap to close: Production identity, account/subscription/project boundaries and naming policy organization ke saath confirm karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Terraform ko pata rahe ki kaunse resources uske control mein hain; state sensitive hoti hai.
AWS implementation and code status: Each environment root has its own local state by default; remote backend is not configured.
Azure implementation and code status: Each environment root has local state by default; the backend.tf sample is commented out.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Each environment root has local state by default; no remote backend is configured.
Production decision or gap to close: Team/production se pehle encrypted remote state, locking, access controls, versioning/backup and tested recovery configure karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Application ke liye isolated IP network boundary.
Azure implementation and code status: Virtual Network 10.10.0.0/16.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Custom-mode VPC, one per environment root.
Production decision or gap to close: CIDRs ko on-prem, peering, VPN, other environments aur private endpoints se non-overlap validate karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Public request ko app tak pahunchane ka controlled entry path.
AWS implementation and code status: Two public ingress subnets across two AZs for the ALB.
Azure implementation and code status: frontend subnet exists but has no resource attached; separate app_gateway subnet hosts Application Gateway.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Global external load balancer is not placed in a subnet; no separate frontend subnet.
Production decision or gap to close: Public exposure ko intentional rakhein; unused Azure frontend subnet ko remove ya design purpose document karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Private app servers yahan run karte hain; direct internet inbound nahi hona chahiye.
AWS implementation and code status: Two private application subnets across two AZs; NAT egress route.
Azure implementation and code status: application subnet; NSG attached; VM has private NIC and NAT Gateway for outbound access.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Private regional app subnet; no VM external IP; Cloud NAT supports outbound traffic.
Production decision or gap to close: Route tables, egress destinations, DNS and subnet sizing ko deployment se pehle validate karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Database/cache jaise stateful services ke liye dedicated boundary.
AWS implementation and code status: Two isolated subnets with VPC-local route only; no database resource.
Azure implementation and code status: data subnet only; no database/cache resource or dedicated NSG association.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Regional data subnet only; no database/cache resource.
Production decision or gap to close: Subnet hona managed database hone ke barabar nahi; service, private endpoint, DNS, backup and HA separately design karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Administrative/operations access ko application traffic se alag rakhna.
AWS implementation and code status: Two isolated subnets with only local route; no management host/service.
Azure implementation and code status: management subnet only; no Bastion or management host/service.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Regional management subnet exists; no management host/service.
Production decision or gap to close: Approved admin access path, identity, logging and emergency access define karein; public SSH/RDP expose na karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Private workload ko required outbound services tak pahunchana without public VM IP.
AWS implementation and code status: NAT Gateway: dev/qa single shared, prod one per AZ; app subnets use NAT.
Azure implementation and code status: NAT Gateway and static public IP attached to application subnet.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Cloud Router and Cloud NAT for all VPC subnets.
Production decision or gap to close: Single-NAT cost/resiliency trade-off, egress allowlists, NAT capacity, logs and regional failure scenario review karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Kaun kis port se kisse baat kar sakta hai uska control.
AWS implementation and code status: Security groups: public ALB 80/443; app HTTP only from ALB; app HTTPS egress.
Azure implementation and code status: App Gateway subnet NSG and application subnet NSG; application HTTP ingress from gateway subnet; outbound rules allow DNS/HTTP/HTTPS and selected platform traffic.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: VPC firewall: load-balancer/health-check ingress, IAP SSH, DNS/web egress and deny-other tagged egress.
Production decision or gap to close: Rules ko least privilege ke saath test karein; Azure frontend/data/management subnet filtering and GCP proxy/health-check source requirements review karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Traffic ko healthy application nodes par route karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Internet-facing Application Load Balancer across two ingress AZs.
Azure implementation and code status: WAF_v2 Application Gateway with autoscale configuration.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Global external managed HTTPS load balancer with HTTP redirect.
Production decision or gap to close: Configure custom DNS, health checks, TLS policy, access logs and tested failover behavior.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Common malicious web requests filter karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Regional AWS WAF with AWS Managed Common Rule Set; attached to ALB.
Azure implementation and code status: Application Gateway WAF_v2 policy, OWASP 3.2, Prevention mode.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Cloud Armor policy with SQLi, XSS and LFI preconfigured rules.
Production decision or gap to close: Production traffic par false positives tune/test karein; WAF logs, alert ownership and rule change process add karein.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Browser aur service ke beech encrypted connection.
AWS implementation and code status: Existing issued ACM certificate ARN required in ALB region; Terraform does not create certificate or DNS record; HTTP redirects to HTTPS.
Azure implementation and code status: Existing PFX certificate in Key Vault required via versionless secret URI; Application Gateway redirects HTTP to HTTPS.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Google-managed certificate is created for required real domain names; public DNS A record to output IP is required before certificate becomes active.
Production decision or gap to close: Domain ownership, renewal/rotation, TLS minimums and certificate expiry alerts verify karein before go-live.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Monolithic application ka runtime host.
AWS implementation and code status: Private EC2 instances in Launch Template/Auto Scaling Group; user-data installs sample Nginx and CloudWatch Agent.
Azure implementation and code status: One private Ubuntu Linux VM per environment; cloud-init installs sample Nginx; no VM scale set.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Private regional Managed Instance Group; startup script installs sample Nginx and Cloud Ops agent.
Production decision or gap to close: Sample Nginx is not the business application. Replace with reviewed immutable image and a repeatable release/rollback pipeline.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Failure par replace/scale karna aur requests healthy nodes ko dena.
AWS implementation and code status: ASG spans two AZs and ALB health checks; no CPU/target-tracking scaling policy is defined; dev can run one instance.
Azure implementation and code status: Single Linux VM per environment; Application Gateway autoscaling does not scale the backend VM.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Regional MIG across up to two available zones; CPU autoscaler and health-based autohealing configured.
Production decision or gap to close: Azure backend HA/scale-out and AWS scaling policy/capacity targets are production gaps; validate zonal capacity and failure drills.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Machines ko secret keys ke bina approved cloud APIs use karne dena.
AWS implementation and code status: EC2 instance profile with SSM managed-instance policy and limited log policy; no SSH key/public IP.
Azure implementation and code status: User-assigned managed identity is for Application Gateway certificate retrieval; VM admin public key is required, but VM has no public IP and no admin access path is deployed.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Dedicated VM service account has log/metric-writer roles; OS Login/IAP settings enabled; human IAP/OS Login grants are separate.
Production decision or gap to close: Review deployer and runtime permissions, emergency access, access reviews and audit logging; avoid long-lived keys.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Password/API token/certificate ko source code se alag rakhna.
AWS implementation and code status: Empty encrypted Secrets Manager secret container; no secret value/version created.
Azure implementation and code status: Key Vault created; existing PFX secret is a prerequisite; no app runtime secret provisioning is configured.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Empty CMEK-encrypted Secret Manager secret container; no secret value/version created.
Production decision or gap to close: Define secret ownership, rotation, access policy/RBAC, version lifecycle and application injection before storing production secrets.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Stored data/logs ko encryption keys se protect karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Rotating KMS key used for CloudWatch logs, S3 encryption and Secrets Manager; KMS alias created.
Azure implementation and code status: Key Vault with purge protection; VM host encryption enabled; Storage Account uses TLS 1.2; customer-managed disk/storage encryption is not wired.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Regional Cloud KMS key with 90-day rotation used for artifact bucket and Secret Manager.
Production decision or gap to close: Document key administrators/users, recovery, rotation, deletion protection and separation of duties; test restore while keys are available.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Build artifacts/log archive ko private, encrypted storage mein rakhna.
AWS implementation and code status: Private, versioned, KMS-encrypted S3 bucket; bucket is not wired as ALB access-log destination.
Azure implementation and code status: Storage Account (prod GRS, non-prod LRS) is created; no diagnostic settings or artifact lifecycle are configured.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Private, uniform-access, versioned CMEK bucket with 30-day retention; force_destroy=false.
Production decision or gap to close: Set lifecycle, immutability where required, replication, access logs and recovery process; confirm actual diagnostic destinations.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Operations/security investigation ke liye logs collect karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Encrypted CloudWatch groups for WAF, Nginx and VPC Flow Logs; Nginx logs forwarded by CloudWatch Agent.
Azure implementation and code status: Log Analytics Workspace and VM boot diagnostics; diagnostic settings/agent routing for resources are not configured.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Regional Logging bucket and project sink for GCE/subnet logs; Cloud Ops agent on VM; load-balancer logging enabled.
Production decision or gap to close: Set useful retention and redaction, enable required Azure diagnostic settings, audit logs and alerts; test searches and incident response.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Service unhealthy ya cost/security event par team ko notify karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Metrics/log groups exist, but no CloudWatch alarm or notification policy is defined.
Azure implementation and code status: Log Analytics Workspace exists; no alert rules/action groups are defined.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Runtime can write metrics; no alert policies/notification channels are defined.
Production decision or gap to close: Define SLOs, paging ownership, thresholds, dashboards and escalation runbooks; test notifications.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Business transactions durable database mein store karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Not created.
Azure implementation and code status: Not created; data subnet only.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Not created; data subnet only.
Production decision or gap to close: Choose managed database, private connectivity, HA/failover, backup retention, encryption and tested restore objectives.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Frequently used data ko fast memory layer se serve karna.
AWS implementation and code status: Not created.
Azure implementation and code status: Not created; data subnet only.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Not created; data subnet only.
Production decision or gap to close: Add only when application needs it; define eviction, persistence, private access and failure behavior.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Users aur private services ko reliable names se resolve karna.
AWS implementation and code status: No DNS zone/record created; ALB DNS name output and ACM certificate supplied separately.
Azure implementation and code status: Public IP gets Azure-generated FQDN; custom DNS zone/records are not created.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: No DNS zone/record created; output global IP must be added as A record for every certificate domain.
Production decision or gap to close: Create controlled DNS ownership, private zones/forwarding and cutover/rollback process.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Accidental deletion ya region outage ke baad recover karna.
AWS implementation and code status: No application/database backup or cross-region recovery plan is configured.
Azure implementation and code status: No Azure Backup or application/data recovery plan is configured.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: No application/database backup or cross-region recovery plan is configured.
Production decision or gap to close: Agree RPO/RTO, backup scope/retention, secondary region and run regular restore/failover exercises.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Code review, tests and safe repeatable release ensure karna.
AWS implementation and code status: No CI/CD or application release pipeline is included.
Azure implementation and code status: No CI/CD or application release pipeline is included.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: No CI/CD or application release pipeline is included.
Production decision or gap to close: Use reviewed immutable artifacts, approvals, policy/security scans, staged rollout and tested rollback.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Org-wide guardrails and compliance evidence maintain karna.
AWS implementation and code status: No organization-level controls or compliance policies are created.
Azure implementation and code status: No Azure Policy, Defender configuration or compliance rules are created.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: No organization/folder policies or compliance controls are created.
Production decision or gap to close: Integrate cloud-native governance, vulnerability management, audit retention and evidence ownership for target standards.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Unexpected cloud bill se bachna.
AWS implementation and code status: ALB, WAF, NAT, EC2, KMS, S3, logs and data transfer incur ongoing charges.
Azure implementation and code status: WAF_v2 Application Gateway, VM, NAT, public IP, Log Analytics and storage incur ongoing charges.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: Global load balancer/IP, Cloud Armor, MIG, NAT, logs, KMS, bucket and egress incur ongoing charges.
Production decision or gap to close: Estimate by region/traffic/log volume, set budgets/alerts, review quotas and run a cost approval before apply.

Simple Hinglish purpose: Change pehle dekhna, accidental deletion avoid karna.
AWS implementation and code status: terraform plan is required; ALB deletion protection only for prod; no remote backend by default.
Azure implementation and code status: Terraform plan is required; Resource Group/storage prevent_destroy are false; backend example is commented.
Google Cloud implementation and code sta: terraform plan is required; bucket force_destroy=false; no remote backend by default.
Production decision or gap to close: Require peer-reviewed plans, protected state, environment approvals, policy checks and tested destroy/recovery procedure.
